name: p-osgoode
js: (()=>{const app=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY;if(!document.body.classList.contains('hud-minimized'))document.getElementById('btn-toggle-hud').click();app.teleportTo(-336.7,-721.1,0);const cut=(x,z)=>C.cutAt?C.cutAt(x,z):0;const cam={pos:[-320,cut(-320,-746)+1.6,-746],look:[-311.6,cut(-311.6,-758.5)+3.2,-758.5],fov:60};app.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>cam;})();(async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(3000);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<5000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log('[perf] p-osgoode '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(2)+' ms')})()
